title: SharePoint Online Records, Retention & Information Governance
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Microsoft 365 SharePoint administration).

SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell and the M365 admin center authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; plan-/version-dependent behavior (licensing/plan tiers, Premium features, Commercial vs Government cloud URLs like *.office365.us) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Third-party devices/apps/tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names. Compliance/legal determinations (records schedules, legal holds, info-barrier policy) deferred to compliance/legal.
hook: Apply records and retention governance to SharePoint content
problem: SharePoint content has to be retained — and disposed — per policy, or it becomes liability. This solution applies records and retention to SPO (scoped to SharePoint content, aligned to the broader Purview program): retention labels and policies for sites/libraries, records declaration and the records-management/disposition workflow, in-place records, and defensible disposition — so SharePoint content is retained, declared, and disposed on schedule.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — SPO records/retention: retention labels + policies, records declaration + in-place records, disposition review, and alignment to the org Purview program.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (compliance licensing, roles, records schedule from records/legal, existing Purview posture).

Implementation Guide — map the retention/records schedule to labels + policies, apply to sites/libraries, configure records declaration + disposition review, and validate — pilot-first; the records schedule itself and legal determinations come from records/legal.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (labels applied, records declared, disposition working) plus Best Practices; determinations deferred to records/legal, broader program to Purview.
short: Apply SharePoint records & retention — retention labels/policies, records declaration + in-place records, and defensible disposition — scoped to SPO content and aligned to your Purview program. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
